did_you_know.title: The Treaty of Montgomery recognises Llywelyn ap Gruffudd as Prince of Wales, but…
did_you_know.text: The Treaty of Montgomery recognises Llywelyn ap Gruffudd as Prince of Wales, but only as a vassal of King Henry III.

did_you_know.title: James Meredith Enrolls at Ole Miss
did_you_know.text: James Meredith became the first Black student to enroll at the University of Mississippi, escorted by federal marshals amid violent riots — a landmark moment in the integration of higher education.
